title: Orbital Presence
description: Orbital presence hangs a body in vacuum over a planet: hard unfiltered sun, no air fill, a sharp planetary limb, the person as a satellite. Put them in orbit: a studio globe behind an actor is not the recipe.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Awe, exile, a god complex: the body is small on purpose, black air, planet occupying the lower or background third. Earth zoom arrives from space.
This one stays there. A street scene cannot fake it with a globe prop.
It is the wrong tool when you need continents collapsing into a face, and the wrong tool when atmosphere wraps the body. Helmet is optional.
HUD text is not: letters garble.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Wide enough to read the planet's limb, 24mm to 35mm, lock-off. Hard sun, deep black, no atmospheric wrap on the figure.
Planet sharp. Figure small.
Prompt: Orbital presence of [Subject], a body hanging over a planet, scale of prayer or threat, the person as a satellite.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Exile in vacuum, a god complex, a prayer over a world. Do not use it as a studio backdrop of Earth, and do not turn it into a zoom to the street.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Gravity puts bodies in hard sun against a planetary limb. Ad Astra hangs a person in black air over worlds.
The still should make the body small on purpose. Grammar, not a copied EVA.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: A person in a studio with an Earth backdrop, or a slide into Earth Zoom. The tell is air wrap and a large figure.
Fix it: vacuum, hard sun, small body, real limb of planet.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Orbital Presence in film?
A vacuum recipe: a body hanging over a planet, hard sun, no air fill, the person as a satellite. It is scale and lighting, not a zoom.
Orbital Presence vs Earth Zoom
Earth zoom collapses planet to street to face. Orbital presence stays in orbit. If continents rush toward the lens, you wanted the cousin.
When should I use Orbital Presence?
Awe, exile, a god complex. Skip street scenes and studio globes.
How do I prompt Orbital Presence for AI image or video?
Small [Subject], planetary limb, hard sun, then: Orbital presence of [Subject], a body hanging over a planet, scale of prayer or threat, the person as a satellite. No HUD. No air wrap.
